title: Adapters make contexts cheap to keep
caption: The book's personalization example: ten full 40 MB context models cost 400 MB, while one shared 40 MB backbone plus ten 200 KB adapters costs about 42 MB. This is storage only; active training memory is a separate budget.

title: Slower networks push the local-work optimum right
caption: The book's illustrative communication-computation cost model places the time-minimizing local-epoch setting near 10 on a fast network and near 40 on a slow network. These are scenario values, not measured convergence results.
